from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialExpenseItem(BaseModel):
    """An extracted financial expense line item from a single filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full legal name of the company in the filing")
    filing_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of filing (e.g., '10-Q', '10-K')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as written (e.g., 'General and administrative')")
    operations_segment: str | None = Field(description="The operational segment (e.g., 'Continuing operations', 'Discontinued operations')")
    amount_value: str | None = Field(description="The numeric amount as written in the document")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars', 'millions')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the expense line")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expense_items: list[FinancialExpenseItem]
